Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.states

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.states
Concrete states of the game's state machine (State Pattern).

Each state extends GameState and implements only the actions allowed in its own phase, throwing an exception for the others:

  • SetUpGameState — lobby: player joining, color selection and game start;
  • StartTurnState — totem placement on the offering tiles;
  • PickingState — card picking;
  • EventState — automatic resolution of the end-of-round events;
  • EndGameState — final resolution and winner proclamation.
